step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram shows video ingestion and transcoding workflow for Huddle. 1. End-user client devices (mobile app, web platform, Huddle focus cameras) upload video content to an S3 bucket and concurrently enqueue job messages into AWS SQS. 2. SQS queue metrics are collected by CloudWatch, which triggers a Lambda function. The Lambda function evaluates queue depth vs instance count and instructs Spot Fleet (Auto Scaling) to scale compute resources. 3. SQS delivers messages to EC2 instances managed by Spot Fleet for video transcoding. 4. Once transcoding completes on EC2, the playable output video is saved back into S3.

graph.name: Huddle Video Transcoding Architecture at Scale
graph.notes: Cost-effective, highly scalable video transcoding pipeline utilizing SQS, Spot Fleet, EC2, Lambda, and CloudWatch.
